message.text: Let me check connect.ts to see how the client is defined there.

q17.

`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`

That module holds the React Query hooks for memo CRUD — `useMemos`/`useInfiniteMemos`, `useMemo`, `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo`, plus comment and link-metadata queries. It imports `memoServiceClient` from `@/connect` (line 5) and calls `listMemos`, `getMemo`, `createMemo`, `updateMemo`, `deleteMemo`, `listMemoComments`, and `getLinkMetadata` on it.

The client itself is created in `web/src/connect.ts:197` as `createClient(MemoService, transport)`, where `MemoService` comes from the generated Connect/protobuf code under `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb`.
